retention_classes.transport_safety: 90 days for envelopes and idempotency keys; sequence cursors and replay floors retained indefinitely
retention_classes.identity_lifecycle: while active plus 90 days after revocation or removal
retention_classes.project_lifecycle: while connected plus 90 days after disconnect or deletion
retention_classes.governance_history: while referenced by a retained run plus the tenant audit-retention period
retention_classes.operational_summary: 90 days by default; tenant may shorten or disable upload before collection
retention_classes.billing_summary: 24 months by default; legal invoice records are outside this event contract

installation.purpose: route and revoke a least-privilege provider installation

repository.purpose: identify an explicitly selected repository without repository contents

device_registration.purpose: identify and revoke a device; public_key is not a credential

project_registration.purpose: bind one local workspace to one explicit tenant project and environment

task_proposal.purpose: offer bounded task metadata to the local proposal inbox

run_summary.purpose: show outcome, timing, commit identities, and named gate results without logs

event_summary.purpose: project a bounded state transition without event body content

agent_state.purpose: show current fleet state and staleness without prompts or transcripts

gate_evidence.purpose: bind a named gate verdict to an exact run and commit without command output

budget_state.purpose: enforce and display attributed budget state without provider credentials or invoice data

role_bundle.purpose: verify an immutable governed role version before local use

policy_bundle.purpose: verify closed allow or deny capability rules locally

approval.purpose: return a decision for an exact versioned subject; action hashes arrive in the later approval-contract version

sync_cursor.purpose: resume offline exchange and prevent duplication or replay
